newsitem.title: USA: Hilton says Mississippi to allow ITT deal.
newsitem.headline: Hilton says Mississippi to allow ITT deal.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp on Thursday said the Mississippi Gaming Commission approved the company's application covering its proposed $6.5 billion acquisition of ITT Corp.
In a statement, Hilton said the action was a regulatory approval and not intended as an endorsement of Hilton's offer for ITT.

Hilton launched a hostile bid in January, and ITT later rejected it as inadequate. Since then ITT has focused on core businesses, including its Sheraton brand hotels and Caesars brand casinos, and sold some non-core assets.
Later on Thursday, the two companies will make oral arguments in federal district court in Las Vegas on a motion by Hilton to compel ITT to hold an annual shareholders meeting in mid-May.
Hilton has nominated a slate of directors to unseat ITT's current board at ITT's next meeting. ITT has traditionally held its meeting in mid-May, but has yet to schedule a date this year.
